title: Land snags: session-end distill, a stopped land's worktree, an orchestrator behind main and a racy hook test
goal: A worker's session-end distill no longer makes land stop at step branch, and a refusal names how long a waiting distill may take; selfcheck's orphans check passes a distill still at work and fails only a stuck one; a land that stops after removing the worker's worktree prints the command that brings it back; land rebases an orchestrator checkout holding only unpushed item-file commits onto origin/main; the hook-wait land test passes in a whole-suite run on a loaded host

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?

notes: Run order 15 of 19 from the 2026-10-12 draft triage: lookup correctness and benchmark measurement first, then kb content, then tooling that fixes recurring sprint failures.
